segments.ja371:1.1: Evaṃbhūtassa te rāja, āgatassa vase [vaso (pī. ka.)] mama;
segments.ja371:1.3: Atthi nu koci pariyāyo, yo taṃ dukkhā pamocaye.
segments.ja371:2.1: Evaṃbhūtassa me tāta, āgatassa vase tava;
segments.ja371:2.3: Natthi no koci pariyāyo, yo maṃ dukkhā pamocaye.
segments.ja371:3.1: Nāññaṃ sucaritaṃ rāja, nāññaṃ rāja subhāsitaṃ;
segments.ja371:4.1: Akkocchi maṃ avadhi maṃ, ajini maṃ ahāsi me;
segments.ja371:4.3: Ye ca taṃ upanayhanti, veraṃ tesaṃ na sammati.
segments.ja371:5.1: Akkocchi maṃ avadhi maṃ, ajini maṃ ahāsi me;
segments.ja371:5.3: Ye ca taṃ nupanayhanti, veraṃ tesūpasammati.
segments.ja371:6.1: Na hi verena verāni, sammantīdha kudācanaṃ;
segments.ja371:6.3: Averena ca sammanti, esa dhammo sanantanoti.
